description: Set several timeseries in one call without shipping every value: each series gives values (full array), OR constant (one number for every period), OR pattern (a short array tiled along the time axis — 24 values on an hourly model is a daily profile, 168 a weekly one; add scale for its peak), OR scale_of (copy another component's series and multiply/offset it). Use load_timeseries_from_file for data that lives in a file.

scale.description: Multiply values/constant/pattern by this — e.g. a 0..1 daily pattern with scale 120 is a 120 MW peak profile.

name: set_timeseries_batch
